en.role: Chair of the Finance Committee of the St. Petersburg government
en.quote: The construction schedule has not changed. That means the southwest will get the metro on schedule.
en.head: Yugo-Zapadnaya and Putilovskaya stations opened to passengers on December 26, 2025.
en.body: The schedule changed several times. According to Vedomosti. Northwest, Beglov named 2024 in April 2023 and promised the stations would open in 2025 in his August 2024 election platform. The result came ten years after the initial deadline.
